name: 07-15fps-noise4-time-jitter
description: Simulated at 15 fps with 4 px landmark noise and ±15 ms of frame-time jitter (uneven frame intervals): 8 full reps (75°). All 8 count. Exercises the time-based (never frame-count) timing, the gap-scaled jump rejection and the dt-aware filters. targetReps 30.
